description: All 9 API route modules + app/main.py. Depends on FEAT-001 (models/core) and FEAT-002 (services). After this FEAT, all unit tests pass including the full API test suite.
steps: Define a serialization helper _row(obj) in each router file that needs it. Pattern: from sqlalchemy import inspect as sa_inspect; from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder; def _row(obj): return jsonable_encoder({c.key: getattr(obj, c.key) for c in sa_inspect(obj.__class__).mapper.column_attrs}). This converts ORM objects to JSON-safe dicts (handles datetime/date/JSON fields).

Create app/api/v1/health.py: router = APIRouter(); GET /health returns {'status': 'ok'} with no auth. This endpoint is tested by test_health_endpoint which calls GET /api/v1/health (health router included with prefix /api/v1 in main.py).

Create app/api/v1/dashboard.py: router = APIRouter(prefix='/dashboard', dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)]). GET /summary: call get_tasks_today_summary(db) for task counts; get_full_context(db) for kpis; get_recent_activity(db, limit=1) for last_activity; return {'tasks_today_total': summary['total'], 'tasks_today_pending': summary['pending'], 'tasks_today_completed': summary['completed'], 'tasks_today_failed': summary['failed'], 'kpis': context.get('kpis', {}), 'last_activity': _row(activities[0]) if activities else None}. GET /activity?limit=50: return [_row(a) for a in await get_recent_activity(db, limit=limit)]. GET /reports/daily: call get_daily_report(db, date.today()); return _row(report) if report else None (must return JSON null, not 404 — the test asserts resp.json() is None).

Create app/api/v1/tasks.py: router = APIRouter(prefix='/tasks', dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)]). Define Pydantic TaskCreate model with fields title:str, agent_type:str, description:str|None=None, priority:int=3. GET / with optional query params status, agent_type, limit=50: return list. POST / body TaskCreate, status_code=201: create_task(db,...) return _row(task). GET /{task_id}: get_task(db, task_id) or raise HTTPException(404).

Create app/api/v1/agents.py: VALID_AGENT_TYPES list of 9 strings (orchestrator, social_media, competitor_research, business_planning, email_outreach, customer_support, ads_management, code_generation, finance). router = APIRouter(prefix='/agents', dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)]). POST /{agent_type}/trigger body=dict Body(default={}) status_code=202: validate agent_type in VALID_AGENT_TYPES else HTTPException(422); create task; 'from celery_app.tasks.agent_tasks import run_agent_task; run_agent_task.delay(task.id)'; return {'status':'queued','task_id':task.id}. GET /status: for each of 9 agent types query latest AgentRun and count runs today; return list of 9 dicts {agent_type, last_run_at, last_status, runs_today}. CRITICAL: exactly 9 items — test asserts len(data)==9.

Create app/api/v1/config.py: router = APIRouter(prefix='/config', dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)]). GET /: first CompanyConfig row or 404. PUT /: body=dict Body(...); get first CompanyConfig or 404; setattr for each key in body if hasattr; flush+refresh; return _row(company). PUT test sends {'name':'New Name','mission':'Updated mission'} and checks both values.
Create app/api/v1/social.py: router = APIRouter(prefix='/social', dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)]). GET /posts?status=&limit=50: optional status filter; return list of _row dicts.

Create app/api/v1/finance.py. CRITICAL DESIGN: the Stripe webhook must NOT have require_api_key (called by Stripe, not our dashboard — test sends no auth header). Use per-endpoint dependencies instead of router-level. GET /summary (auth), GET /revenue?limit=30 (auth, DESC by snapshot_date), GET /expenses?category=&limit=50 (auth, optional category filter), GET /events?limit=50 (auth). POST /stripe/webhook (NO auth): if not settings.stripe_webhook_secret raise HTTPException(500); payload=await request.body(); sig=request.headers.get('stripe-signature',''); try stripe.Webhook.construct_event(payload, sig, settings.stripe_webhook_secret) except: raise HTTPException(400); return {'received': True}. Finance summary returns zeros when no snapshot with key 'last_snapshot_date': None.

Create app/api/v1/memory.py: router = APIRouter(prefix='/memory', dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)]). Define MemoryCreate Pydantic model with category:str, title:str, content:str, tags:list[str]=[]. POST / status_code=201: await store_memory(db,...); return _row(entry). GET /?q=&category=&limit=50: if q param present call search_memory(db,q,n_results=limit) and return list of dicts directly (already dicts from service); else call list_memories(db,category=category,limit=limit) and return [_row(m) for m in entries]. CRITICAL: test_list_memory_empty has NO mock_chroma — list_memories must NOT call get_collection().

Create /Users/gauravshewale/Development/business/NFC/polsia/app/main.py. FastAPI(title='Polsia AI Business Agent'). Add CORSMiddleware(allow_origins=['*'], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*']). Include all 8 routers with prefix='/api/v1': health, dashboard, tasks, agents, config, social, finance, memory. Add WebSocket endpoint at /ws/activity that subscribes to Redis pubsub channel 'polsia:activity' and streams messages to connected clients. Import get_redis lazily inside the websocket handler (not at module top) to avoid real Redis connection at import time.

findings: All 61 unit tests pass (76.25% coverage, above 75% threshold). Two issues encountered and fixed: (1) routes defined with '/' path caused 307 redirects — fixed by using '' for root-level endpoints in tasks, config, and memory routers; (2) activity_service imported get_redis directly via 'from ... import get_redis' creating a local binding that bypassed the conftest patch — fixed by accessing get_redis through the module reference (import app.core.redis_client as _redis_module). Also implemented FEAT-002 (services and agents) as a prerequisite since those modules were absent.
